purpose: CS-72 and CS-76 contrast lines, requested in CS-C444. Written by Claude, who read the s4-bob-r1 contract but not judge.py's word lists, Bob's need catalog or any candidate rules. Learner lines only; bob_before is context for the reader.

fields.praise: Should the learner see positive empathy feedback? yes, no, or either when both are defensible.
fields.signal: Stance signals acceptable under the contract's precedence table. The first is the expected one.
fields.not_signal: Signal that would be wrong even where the line is otherwise ambiguous.

use: Report pass or fail per line. A failed line is a lexical limit to disclose, not a line to reword or drop. These lines are visible to the implementer, so they are not held out.
